# web-vitals

GoogleChrome/web-vitals 6.2.3, Apache-2.0. Official package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/web-vitals

`web-vitals.js` is the unmodified ES module from the pinned package's `dist/web-vitals.js`. License: `web-vitals-LICENSE.txt`. It calculates webpage INP; native response and long-frame samples are measured separately. This module is served locally and does not contact a third party.
